pr_title: clear auto-follow errors on deleting pattern
pr_body:
This change clears auto-follow errors that belongs to patterns that are removed by cluster update.

Closes: #77723

issue_context.title: CCR clear recent auto-follow errors
issue_context.body: If auto-following fails, we keep the most recent error per auto-follow pattern around for inclusion into ccr stats. However, when the auto-follow pattern is deleted, we still keep the recent errors and still report them into ccr stats. This can cause confusion, since the ccr stats endpoints report errors that are no longer relevant. Instead we should clear out the recent error for auto-follow patterns that are deleted.

review_comments: I think we should set the patterns to the empty list above when `autoFollowMetadata == null` too (though I think we never go back to null, so mostly for completeness).
I believe we are also not clearing/stopping `autoFollowers` once metadata is null. If this happens for whatever reason then it might result in auto-followers still running but not producing any stats
Good point, perhaps we can simply add an assert before the return above to express the intent here?
